title: Unusual login and unfamiliar IP response
description: Guidance for unfamiliar-IP logins after failed attempts.
conditions: Unfamiliar source IP and/or repeated failed logins preceding a success.
text: When an employee account successfully logs in from an unfamiliar IP after several failed login attempts, analysts must investigate supporting event logs. For a sensitive account, recommend simulated session revocation after human approval. Do not assert compromise without enough evidence.
investigation_guidance: Cite supporting EVT-* IDs, note IP familiarity, and keep compromise language unconfirmed until additional evidence exists.

title: Privileged Finance account protection
description: Prioritization guidance for Finance and other privileged accounts.
conditions: Account belongs to Finance or another privileged workflow; unfamiliar or burst login patterns observed.
text: Finance admin accounts are sensitive because of potential access to financial workflows. Analysts should prioritize unfamiliar login IP alerts for Finance accounts, review access logs and consider a password reset recommendation after approval. Business harm is potential unless verified.
investigation_guidance: Raise investigation priority for privileged accounts without adding automatic risk-score bonuses based on department alone.

title: Approval and incident audit
description: Human-approval and audit requirements for simulated containment.
conditions: Any containment or session-revocation recommendation is proposed.
text: A containment recommendation must not execute before authorized human approval. Any simulated decision must record the incident identifier, analyst identity, decision, timestamp and outcome.
investigation_guidance: Record one simulated Approve or Reject decision per validated AI report; never claim a real account change occurred.

title: Evidence handling standard
description: Standards for distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses.
conditions: Any AI or analyst explanation of login activity.
text: Investigation summaries must distinguish observed login events from hypotheses. Cite event identifiers for evidence and policy identifiers for guidance. Missing evidence must be stated clearly.
investigation_guidance: Preserve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when unfamiliar IP alone is present; do not invent missing IP or timestamp context.
